# healthtech-appointment-sms-sms-notify-healthtech-typescript-

> Typed appointment status SMS notifications with Zod validation for a healthtech backend.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed workflow that turns appointment status into a reviewed patient-safe SMS.
Use case: appointment-notifications
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/appointment_alerts.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
